title: Bounds on the limiting weight error
statement: For every odd natural number $k$, the error between the limiting majority Fourier weight and $(2/\pi)^{3/2}k^{-3/2}$ lies between $0$ and $(2/\pi)^{3/2}k^{-5/2}$.
